249399.summary: Only vendor is Mister Graphed (Agent of the Black Market) in Riverglades, at 4g 50s each with unlimited stock (the game files say 1s 20c, but Black Market agents charge far more). So it's not a vendor flip: buying there costs far more than it sells for on the AH. It's a crafting reagent and can be gathered from herb nodes.
